Grading note for triage · 2026-11-19T17:15Z
Correcting the filing's p1 suggestion. Cloud answered on #35457 (comment 7016425225): hosted does not arm the inbound rate limiter on either plane, because it declares no budget. So the limiter read in this card never runs on hosted, and PR #35598 alone takes hosted's dispatcher session read from 2 to 1 (cloud#4563 re-measures once a pin carries it). That leaves the REST door's second read, `decideAuthGate` under `reread-when-active`, which runs only when an ADR-0069 session gate is active. This card is a framework improvement, not cloud's blocker. Grade it on that basis.
